items.title: Greg Caputo interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 14, 1998
items.q: he left his saxophone to the Brubeck son who did not choose to play music

ctx.x: His other son is quite a good drummer.

Danny, yeah, excellent. They’re all fine musicians and something that I found out — that when Paul Desmond passed away he left his saxophone to the Brubeck son who did not choose to play music, in hopes that someday he would pick up the saxophone, which I thought was very interesting.
Now let’s see you’ve mentioned Buddy Rich and Gene Krupa and Joe Morello. Who is the player that you like to listen to who you would consider, oh let’s say the most modern?
